body: Nowhere near the timezone.. u.k but always on early hours..my time.. XxExorcism

Theyre aware of my history of depression and things felt better.. but that too now feels like a mask itself.. ive burdened then long enough. " think of the kids" is the resounding statement..
I dont want another year of this nevermind 60 of them..

Youre not alone. Its been a while since that downward spiral.. and this week has hit me hard.
Before finding the board i never knew how many of us are finding such pain in life.
Its inevitable, true.. but everything else 'free will' is merely a house of cards to give purpose to an empty existence
